answer_1.quote: Among these tasks, automated code repair and commit message generation are the two most active and closely related tasks. [...] The latter aims to generate natural language descriptions of code changes.

answer_2.quote: For the code repair, we use exact match accuracy to measure the percentage of the predicted fixed code that are exactly matching the truth fixed code. In addition, we also introduce the BLEU-4 score as a supplementary metric [...] For the commit message generation, we use BLEU-4 and Rouge-L.
